inflation_breadth.methodology: National CPI; published monthly YoY rates; core excludes food and energy. No interpolation. Earlier COICOP 1999 history can precede a short COICOP 2018 series. Breadth is an unweighted country count; euro area excluded. Easing/rising compares the exact month three months earlier; +/-0.05 pp is little changed.
